nodes.label: Modular Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: Clear module boundaries and provider interfaces allow components to be extracted into services later if scale requires it.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture Pattern
nodes.rationale: Inward dependency direction: Domain depends on nothing, Application depends only on Domain.

nodes.label: Tenant Isolation Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Every tenant-scoped read and write passes through the single authorization helper. Cross-tenant resources return 404.

nodes.label: Secrets & Redaction Policy
nodes.rationale: Redaction list lives in the logger itself. Passwords, TOTP, tokens, session cookies, and message bodies are never logged.

nodes.label: Licensing & Over-Allowance Policy
nodes.rationale: Licence service unreachable keeps mail flowing. Over allowance blocks new mailboxes only; never destroys existing data.
